examples: Say it again.
I will try again.
Let us play again.

more.def: Once more, or as it was before.
examples: The pond froze again after the warm days ended.
Read the first page again so we can hear it clearly.
I hope to visit the lake again next summer.
Put the ladder against the wall.
I sat against the tree.
The rain tapped against the window.

more.def: Pressing on or touching something for support or from the side.
examples: The bike was propped against the fence.
Waves crashed against the rocks all night.
He rested his back against the warm stone wall.
Our team plays against the blue team.
I raced against my sister.
Mom played against me at cards.

more.def: Competing with someone in a contest, or not agreeing with something.
examples: The soccer team plays against its rivals from the next town on Saturday.
Many people voted against building a loud factory near the park.
Is it against the rules to touch the ball with your hands?

easy.def: A person who helps other people with a job.
examples: The travel agent booked our trip.
My aunt is a ticket agent.
An agent helped us find a house.

more.def: A person who acts for others, or whose job is to provide a service.
examples: The travel agent booked our flights and hotel.
An agent helped the family find a new house.
A ticket agent checked our bags.

easy.def: In the past, counting back from now.
examples: I came a week ago.
It was long ago.
She left an hour ago.

more.def: Back in the past from the present time.
examples: Dinosaurs lived millions of years ago.
My grandparents moved here fifty years ago.
The rain stopped just a few minutes ago.

easy.def: To think the same thing as someone else.
examples: We both agree that pizza is yummy.
Do you agree that dogs are fun?
We agree to take turns.

more.def: To have the same opinion as someone, or to say yes to something.
examples: Everyone agreed that the park was the best place for the picnic.
The two teams agreed on the rules before the game began.
I agree with you that we should leave early.
